## Core Focus Areas & Interests

### 1. Autonomous Agents & Agentic Infrastructure
- Multi-agent fleet coordination and delegation architectures.
- Agent harness design, dynamic execution loops, and practical tool-use environments.
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) server design, remote endpoints, and tool integrations.
- Headless browser automation via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) and multi-environment workflows.
- Evaluation of real-world model constraints, execution reliability, latency, and token economics.

### 2. Systems & High-Performance Engineering
- High-efficiency, low-footprint services and local utilities in Rust.
- Scalable backend architectures, API engineering, and distributed design.
- Linux systems internals, containerization, local process harnesses, and shell automation.

### 3. Developer Platforms & Work Operating Systems
- Building tooling that eliminates developer friction and automates complex routine human workflows.
- Enterprise systems integrating employee lifecycles, project pods, and collaboration infrastructure.

### 4. Academic & Campus Infrastructure
- Building accessible platforms and MCP endpoints unlocking locked university ERP and LMS systems directly for AI assistants.

---

## Key Projects

### Featured Systems & Agent Work
- **Ctrl:** High-performance personal assistant and driver daemon built in Rust utilizing SQLite and embedded HTTP services.
- **LVC WorkOS:** Enterprise unified work operating system covering lifecycle management, attendance, timezone synchronization, and collaboration pods.
- **KLMCP:** Remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server bridging university ERP and LMS systems directly into AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT) via authenticated endpoints without central database overhead. (https://github.com/Lokkuchakreshkumar/KLMCP)
- **Autonomous Fleet & Bot Harnesses:** Multi-agent local orchestration environments managing background ingestion, briefings, and task execution.

### Featured Web & Academic Platforms
- **GoSynk:** Comprehensive collaborative study platform offering synchronized flashcards, notes, AI chatbot tutoring, quizzes, and interactive learning tools. (https://gosynk.vercel.app | https://github.com/Lokkuchakreshkumar/gosynk)
- **KLED (KLU-Desk):** Academic study and course resource portal featuring curated notes, flashcards, interactive quizzes, and AI assistance. (https://kled.vercel.app | https://github.com/Lokkuchakreshkumar/KLU-DESK)
- **SkillDex:** Interactive skills roadmap, verification, and technical exploration platform. (https://myskilldex.vercel.app | https://github.com/Lokkuchakreshkumar/SkillDex)
- **UsaLai:** AI assistant interface for interactive productivity workflows. (https://github.com/Lokkuchakreshkumar/lai)
- **Homer & newPortfolio:** Modern reactive portfolio ecosystem designed for high performance, minimalism, and custom theme customization. (https://chakresh.vercel.app | https://github.com/Lokkuchakreshkumar/newPortfolio)

## Technical Stack & Skills

- **Languages:** Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL, HTML5, CSS3.
- **Frontend & UI:** React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Motion, Zustand.
- **Backend & Systems:** Rust (`rusqlite`, `serde`, `tiny_http`), Node.js, Express.js, Linux / Shell.
- **Databases & Data Storage:** SQLite, DuckDB, MongoDB.
- **AI & Automation:** Model Context Protocol (MCP), Gemini API, Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), Agent harnesses.
- **Deployment & Tooling:** Vercel, Git, GitHub.
